name: Canadian Cadets (Sea, Army and Air Cadets)
org: Department of National Defence (Government of Canada)
city: Local corps and squadrons across British Columbia
what_you_do: Join a local Sea, Army or Air Cadet corps or squadron. It is a national youth program with challenging activities and training. You pick the cadet element that interests you.
who_can_apply: Young people who are at least 12 and have not reached 19. Have your health card ready when you register.
pay_detail: The pages read do not state a cost. The program page calls it a funded program. Ask the local unit about any fees.
duration: Not stated on the pages read
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register online and the unit staff contact you.
how_to_apply: Choose Sea, Army or Air Cadets. Find a unit near you in the Corps and Squadron Directory. Register with the Online Registration Tool. Have your health card and your parents' contact details ready. Then unit staff contact you to check ID and welcome you.
notes: This is a Canada-wide program. The units in British Columbia come from the national directory. The British Columbia work rule is not verified for this card. A youth program, not a paid job.
